en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Ethiopia–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on dividends where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Ethiopia–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 10 per cent source-State ceiling on interest where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with source-State exemption for qualifying government, subnational or local authority, central bank, export or foreign-investment promotion institution, and qualifying guaranteed or secured financing. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Ethiopia–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
